consequence.statement: Existing ExternalSecret resources continue to work without modification; the new field is optional and enables new refresh policy configuration options for operators who wish to use them.

original.statement: A new optional field `spec.refreshPolicy` has been added to the ExternalSecret v1beta1 API, allowing configuration of how the ExternalSecret should be refreshed (CreatedOnce, Periodic, or OnChange).
